surprises: NFRA_DEVPLN-W2-S1: the approval reader the script consumes (python .tools/open-calls.py approval-status) is absent at 38ac43222d, so a default-path run refuses status-unreadable until the sibling cell lands

NFRA_DEVPLN-W2-S3: the AC3 grep has no comment exclusion, so its 'comments excepted' clause cannot hold for a comment that names git with rebase or a force option
